text: Official MCP server lets an AI assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace within limits you set
quote: The Thoropass MCP server lets your AI assistant help with that work right where you're already working, so you don't have to export data and upload it somewhere else.

text: MCP tool permissions are configurable so you can add or remove what the agent is allowed to do
quote: Add or remove the last three depending on what you want your agent to be able to do.

text: Via MCP, list audits and view audit details, evidence requests, and the systems tied to them
quote: List audits and view audit details ... List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them

text: Via MCP, add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests
quote: Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests

text: Ask natural-language questions such as which evidence requests are still outstanding on an audit
quote: "What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?"

text: Access reviews remind you to start reviews according to your policy's timelines
quote: Remind you to to start your reviews according to your policy's timelines.

text: Access reviews validate access changes before the review is finished to prevent change-management errors
quote: Validate your access changes before finishing your review, preventing costly errors in your change management process.

text: Consecutive access reviews focus only on changes since the last review, claimed to save up to 95% of workload
quote: Thoropass is the only compliance solution that offers optimized consecutive access reviews automation, allowing you to focus only on changes since the last review and saving up to 95% of the workload.

text: Head Start reuses data from previous access reviews to speed up future reviews
quote: Leverage data from previous access reviews to speed up future reviews using Head Start.

text: Access reviews automate gathering of audit evidence
quote: Access reviews with Thoropass will: Remind you to to start your reviews according to your policy's timelines... Automate the gathering of evidence for audits (when applicable).

text: Access reviews suggest the most important in-scope and critical systems to review
quote: Suggest the most important in-scope and critical systems to review.

text: Risk Register gives a 360-degree view to track, evaluate, and remediate risk
quote: Thoropass Risk Register provides a 360-degree view into your risk landscape, enabling you to efficiently track, evaluate, and remediate risk

text: Risk Register dashboard supports a 4×4 or 5×5 risk scoring configuration
quote: Quickly stand up your dashboard in a flexible 4×4 or 5×5 risk configuration to meet your unique business needs and risk assessment methodology

text: A role can manage assigned risks, including modifying the controls and action items linked to them
quote: The new role can manage assigned risks in Risk Register, including modifying controls and action items linked to those risks, streamlining risk accountability and improving efficiency.

text: Account Admins manage user access across all workspaces linked to their account
quote: Account Admins can now efficiently manage Thoropass user access across all workspaces linked to their account, providing greater control

text: Monitors page gives a centralized view of active compliance monitors to assess system health and investigate violations
quote: The Monitors page gives you a centralized view of all active compliance monitors in your workspace. From this screen, you can quickly assess system health, investigate violations, and manage your audit readiness.

text: Monitors automatically check connected AWS, Azure, or GCP systems against control requirements
quote: Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.

text: Compliance data is collected automatically, with alerts on compliance violations
quote: Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations

text: Monitors and integrations refresh data daily or ad hoc
quote: Please ensure these five IP addresses are allowed. Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc

text: Auditor-vetted native integrations connect business tools and automatically satisfy evidence requests
quote: Thoropass integrations are vetted and approved by auditors. High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.

text: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence before the audit to reduce rejections and manual QA
quote: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence before the audit, eliminating the bottlenecks between evidence collection and auditor acceptance, saving thousands of manual QA hours and accelerating audit cycle times.

text: Unified task view and visual dashboard for managing and assigning tasks across frameworks and workspaces
quote: Simplify multi-framework and multi-workspace compliance with a unified task view and a visual dashboard to efficiently manage and assign tasks.

text: Frameworks are mapped to a single core Unified Control list so requirements already met by another framework are not repeated
quote: Our expert team of auditors has mapped our offered frameworks to a single, core control list, giving you a centralized location to view and act on your organization's Action Items.

text: Guides map SOC 2, HIPAA, and HITRUST framework controls to their corresponding Unified Controls
quote: If you're used to working with a specific SOC 2 framework control, you can use this guide to identify its corresponding Unified Control.

text: View framework-specific controls alongside Unified Controls
quote: Thoropass is expanding the way you view and manage compliance controls by giving you the ability to view framework controls alongside our existing Unified Controls.

text: Unified dynamic action items reduce repetition and visualize the differences between frameworks
quote: The new action items reduce repetition with unified Action Items and visualize the differences between frameworks for faster action.

text: Compliance Roadmap filters Unified Controls by framework and groups them by status, owner, activity type, and milestone
quote: From the Compliance Roadmap, you can filter the list of Unified Controls by framework, and group controls by Status, Owner, Activity Type, and Milestone.

text: Roadmap can be filtered by control owner for a role-based view of controls
quote: The Roadmap view can be filtered by control owner, giving program owners a role-based view of their organization's controls.

text: Create custom Unified Controls for controls Thoropass doesn't offer
quote: You can create custom Unified Controls to track and implement controls that aren't currently offered by Thoropass.

text: Shared Controls let multi-workspace organizations share controls, with changes reflected across workspaces
quote: Shared Controls is an optional feature that allows multi-workspace organizations to share controls across two or more of their workspaces.

text: Assign control owners responsible for the health and function of each control
quote: A control owner is the person assigned to manage a given control. The control owner is responsible for the health and function of their control

text: Dashboard shows total controls and controls with owners, and flags controls that need attention
quote: If any controls need attention, Thoropass will flag them here so you can make sure you're not missing any critical compliance activity.

text: Pentesting findings map directly to PCI controls and action plans and flow into remediation and audit reporting
quote: Thoropass brings pentesting, compliance, and audit together in one connected experience, so findings flow directly into remediation and audit-ready reporting.

text: PCI Council-approved external ASV vulnerability scans are integrated into audit and compliance workflows
quote: Thoropass provides PCI Council–approved external vulnerability scans—seamlessly integrated into your audit and compliance workflows.

text: Supports PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, and HITRUST programs on the same multi-framework platform
quote: Adding GDPR to your compliance program is simple and painless with Thoropass's multi-framework approach

text: HITRUST Accredited Assessor and audit platform guide you from scoping through validation
quote: Thoropass combines readiness, automation, and assessment in one connected experience, with a HITRUST Accredited Assessor and AI-powered Audit Lifecycle Platform guiding you from scoping through validation

text: HIPAA readiness, evidence collection, and third-party assessment are delivered together
quote: Thoropass brings HIPAA readiness, evidence collection, and third-party assessment together in one connected experience

text: Audits run in one platform from scoping to final report, connecting evidence, progress, and auditors
quote: Thoropass connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report.

text: Automation to create, review, and acknowledge published policies
quote: Accelerate the ability to create, review, and acknowledge published policies with direct automation.

text: Admins can enable a strict publishing flow that requires a separate Approver's sign-off before a policy is published
quote: Admins can now toggle on a more strict publishing flow for policies in their company. The new workflow requires a separate Approver's sign-off before any policy is published.

text: Centralized communications page with filters and search for controls and evidence requests
quote: The new feature keeps all communication across Thoropass in one page... you can use filters and search tools to quickly find what you need

text: Autofill automation for questionnaires, plus a GenAI DDQ feature
quote: How to Use the Autofill Automation for Questionnaires

text: AI Helpbot answers questions from approved support docs and is opened with cmd/ctrl+K
quote: The AI Helpbot is designed to assist users by answering questions based on approved Thoropass support and documentation content.

text: Assistant clarifies Thoropass workflows and compliance framework requirements such as SOC, PCI, and HITRUST
quote: Customers typically use the Assistant to: Clarify Thoropass workflows and best practices, Understand compliance framework requirements (SOC, PCI, HITRUST, etc.)

text: Admins setting up for the first time get a guided Onboarding Mode for the compliance program
quote: If you are an administrator of the Thoropass platform and this is your first time logging in, you will enter into Onboarding Mode to begin setting up your organization's compliance program.

text: HIPAA breach notification template with placeholders for incident-specific details
quote: A breach notification template is available to meet HIPAA reporting standards, including placeholders for incident-specific details.
